normalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 visible terminal-cell rows after ANSI-control removal and outer-whitespace trimming. Every row also pins exact raw projected and rendered hashes plus one-based inclusive blank-column ranges.
policy: Fail-closed reconciliation of every earlier adjacent-block final acceptance after Batch 42. Only previously accepted generic command, option, conference, empty-field, and placement placeholders are included. Artwork, attribution, identities, titles, functional copy, and structural text remain intact.
